children: Kuwait-based Jazeera Airways has launched its biggest-ever sale, giving travellers the chance to buy one ticket and get the second for free for travel across the airline’s entire network. A total of 3 million seats will be up for grabs starting from midnight (September 20) until September 26.

The sale also comes as Jazeera Terminal 5 (T5) at Kuwait International Airport returns to 24-hour operations, providing passengers with greater flexibility and convenience as Jazeera Airways continues to expand its flight schedule and connectivity from Kuwait, said a statement from Jazeera Airways.

Whether it is a quick getaway within the GCC, a winter break in Prague or Krakow, exploring Africa through Addis Ababa, discovering Aswan and the Nile, or visiting family and friends across the Middle East and South Asia, Jazeera Airways’ biggest-ever sale puts twice the travel within easier reach.
With 3 million seats included in the offer and a travel period running from September 24 to March 27, the promotion covers more than six months of travel, it added.

Announcing this, Paul Carroll, Chief Commercial Officer, Jazeera Airways, said: "This is our biggest-ever sale, with 3 million winter seats included in our Buy One, Get One Free offer across the entire Jazeera Airways network."

"With T5 now back to 24-hour operations and almost six months of travel included in the promotion, there has never been a better time for our passengers to plan their next journey. Whether it is a winter holiday, a family visit, a trip with friends or simply an opportunity to discover somewhere new, this offer makes it easier to travel together and experience more for less," stated Carroll.
"Passengers booking eligible flights can use promo code J9B1G1 to capture even more opportunities to travel with family and friends for less," he added.-

title: ZAWYA: Jazeera Airways offers 3mln seats in biggest-ever sale
